name: r2-geglu-row640-efm
author: solx-loop
description: E1 (H14) finds no read-path cap. Clean-L2 plain loads stream at 7.4-7.5 TB/s marginal. The full kernel runs at 86-88% of DRAM peak (ncu). The dirty-flush write-back (155 MB at 503 MB) sets the L time, and no access order changes it. Swizzles, prefetch-ahead, reversed order and two rows per thread all tie or lose.
